evidence.title: Canton Network published coin fee-reference price at signing (0.0005 USD/CC) - illustrative
evidence.accessNotes: Protocol-set fee-denomination parameter, not an exchange quote. No order book or settled arm's-length trade behind it.

evidence.title: Informal OTC Canton Coin quotes and self-reported trades from Telegram channels, Jan 2026 - illustrative
evidence.accessNotes: Informal peer-to-peer asks, bids, and self-reported off-chain trades captured from Telegram OTC channels around the 2026-01-15 signing date. Not an exchange; not binding; thin volume; counterparties and settlement unverified. Weak but corroborating Level 3 evidence of a secondary market above the fee-reference price.
